scenes.title: Escape from Kharsan
scenes.rationale: Opening reconnaissance recap and the flight from the bridge form one immediate problem: reach the horses before the alerted orcs.
scenes.overview: The party escapes the bridge and reaches its horses as an orc patrol pursues.
scenes.transitionToNext: Reaching the horses turns the escape into a choice of route and a long ride across the desert.

scenes.title: Light and Water in the Desert
scenes.rationale: The first two travel days share the same objective, destination, and survival pressures: reach Havdar’s camp while conserving water and preparing against shadows.
scenes.overview: They ride northwest, keep the first camp lit, and use a desert wren’s guidance to find extra water on the second evening.
scenes.transitionToNext: During the second night’s watch, movement outside the light becomes an ambush.

scenes.title: The Midnight Ambush
scenes.rationale: These are contiguous tactical phases of one fight, followed by its immediate consequences and the completion of the interrupted rest.
scenes.overview: Daylight and a magnesium flare help defeat two shadows and three shadow dogs, but two pack horses are killed.
scenes.transitionToNext: Dawn ends the interrupted rest; the lost horses make the onward journey slower.

scenes.title: Havdar’s Empty Camp
scenes.rationale: The journey to the camp, discovery that Havdar has left, and decision to detour to the stone house form one travel and destination-choice sequence; the two-day detour is a brief montage.
scenes.overview: They reach the intact spring camp, strengthen their defenses, then follow Kenzo’s duty to report to the Mystai.
scenes.transitionToNext: Arrival at the stone house changes travel and planning into a conversation with Pava and Avaras.

scenes.title: Stories at the Stone House
scenes.rationale: Welcome, dinner, questions, warnings, and the overnight visit share the same location, cast, and purpose.
scenes.overview: Kenzo shares his initiation; the hosts suggest Candrosa and Saka as contacts, and Seeker gives them a carved keepsake.
scenes.transitionToNext: After staying overnight, the party leaves on the return journey to Karawa.

scenes.title: Return to Karawa
scenes.rationale: The final travel montage and welcome in town form the session’s closing return, with a new conversation deferred until the next session.
scenes.overview: The party passes Bas Udda, reaches Karawa on May 23, and learns that Tharandros wants to speak with them.
